Escanercillo includes the following third-party software and adaptations.

jscanify, Copyright (c) 2023 ColonelParrot and contributors. MIT.
https://github.com/puffinsoft/jscanify/tree/954863b80e8407bbd2a659fcba6583ce3176a419
The upstream browser build is included as jscanify.js.

react-perspective-cropper, Copyright (c) 2020 Giacomo Cerquone. MIT.
https://github.com/giacomocerquone/react-perspective-cropper/tree/b1d2756b914d835af6fb79b954e54f939a577bb7
The four-point OpenCV transform workflow was adapted for a browser worker
with Euclidean sizing, cubic interpolation and normalized coordinates.

AndroidDocumentFilter, by Naman Garg. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/garg-lucifer/AndroidDocumentFilter/tree/971a0fa8e6d637a32cecf6d985810c039fc3ee47
The illumination estimation approach from ShadowRemovelFilter was adapted
to a downsampled luminance map with an independent normalization pipeline.

OpenCV.js and pdf-lib are installed from npm. See the package licenses.
